name: Callisto CI & Validation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  merge_group:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  workflow-contracts:
    name: Workflow Contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install workflow validation tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2
        with:
          tool: ripgrep,zizmor@1.30.0
      - name: Lint workflow and action metadata
        # actionlint v1.7.12 predates GitHub's documented $/ self-repository
        # syntax. Keep all other actionlint diagnostics strict.
        uses: docker://rhysd/actionlint@sha256:9d36088643581e728c969f35141f88139fec77280b2be23c1f66f8e40e1025e7 # v1.7.12
        with:
          # Docker action arguments are passed directly, rather than through a
          # shell. Keep the exception as one argument so its regex is intact.
          args: -color -ignore=\$/.+
      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - name: Audit workflow and action security
        run: just zizmor
      - name: Verify workflow contracts
        run: just workflow-contracts

  fmt:
    name: Code Formatting (Moon & Just)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build one declared Callisto product artifact. This script deliberately owns
# only platform compilation and archive layout; Callisto owns all release
# planning, artifact identity, provenance verification, and publication.
set -euo pipefail

: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND:?must name cli or cross}"
: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET:?must name a supported Rust target}"
: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET:?must name the expected release asset}"
: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT:?must name the checked-out source root}"
: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR:?must name an output directory}"

kind="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND"
target="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET"
asset="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET"
source_root="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT"
artifact_dir="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR"

case "$kind:$target:$asset" in
  cli:aarch64-apple-darwin:callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz | \
  cli:x86_64-apple-darwin:callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz | \
  cli:x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu:callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | \
  cli:aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu:callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | \
  cross:x86_64-unknown-linux-musl:callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz)
    ;;
  *)
    printf 'unsupported Callisto release artifact: kind=%s target=%s asset=%s\n' \
      "$kind" "$target" "$asset" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

mkdir -p "$artifact_dir"

case "$kind" in
  cli)
    rustup target add "$target"
    (cd "$source_root" && cargo build --locked --release -p callisto-cli --target "$target")
    tar -C "$source_root/target/$target/release" -czf "$artifact_dir/$asset" callisto
    ;;
  cross)
    rustup target add "$target"
    cargo install cross --locked --version 0.2.5
    (cd "$source_root" && cross build --locked --release -p callisto-cli --target "$target")
    tar -C "$source_root/target/$target/release" -czf "$artifact_dir/$asset" callisto
    ;;
esac

ci_workflow=.github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml
checkout_count=$(rg -n 'uses: actions/checkout@' "$ci_workflow" | wc -l)
credential_free_checkout_count=$(rg -n 'persist-credentials: false' "$ci_workflow" | wc -l)
if [[ "$checkout_count" != "$credential_free_checkout_count" ]]; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: every Callisto CI checkout must disable persisted credentials\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

require_line "$version_pr" '          persist-credentials: false' 'version-pr never git-pushes -- it commits through the forge API -- so it must not persist Git credentials'

  printf 'workflow contract failed: PR CI must run the behavioral release workflow harness\n' >&2

fi

if ! rg -Fqx '  release-artifact-preflight:' "$ci_workflow"; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: PR CI must preflight every production artifact build recipe\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! rg -Fqx '        run: just workflow-contracts' "$ci_workflow" \
  || ! rg -Fqx '    bash .github/tests/test-release-artifact-build-script.sh' justfile; then

fi

  printf 'workflow contract failed: artifact preflight must cover all three product targets\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

def table_agreement(paths):
    """Every hand-copied target/asset table must equal callisto.toml's [release] artifacts."""
    errs = []
    try:
        import tomllib
        with open(paths["config"], "rb") as f:
            release = tomllib.load(f).get("release", {})
        rust = {(a["target"], a["asset-name"]) for a in release.get("artifact", [])}
        template = release.get("asset-name")
        if template:
            rust |= {(t, template.replace("{target}", t)) for t in release.get("targets", [])}
    except ImportError:  # python < 3.11: read the tables by text
        text = open(paths["config"]).read()
        rust = set(re.findall(r'target\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"\s*\nasset-name\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', text))
        template = re.search(r'^asset-name\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', text, re.M)
        targets = re.search(r'^targets\s*=\s*\[([^\]]*)\]', text, re.M)
        if template and targets:
            rust |= {(t, template.group(1).replace("{target}", t)) for t in re.findall(r'"([^"]+)"', targets.group(1))}
    if not rust:
        return [f"{paths['config']}: no [release] target/asset-name pairs found"]
    rust_assets = {a for _, a in rust}

    def compare(label, found):
        for t, a in sorted(rust - found):
            errs.append(f"{label}: missing ({t}, {a}) declared in {paths['config']}")
        for t, a in sorted(found - rust):
            errs.append(f"{label}: ({t}, {a}) disagrees with {paths['config']}")

    compare(f"{paths['release']} build-artifact matrix", matrix_pairs(paths["release"], "build-artifact"))
    ci = load(paths["ci"])
    ci_pairs = set()
    for job in ci["jobs"].values():
        for e in (job.get("strategy") or {}).get("matrix", {}).get("include", []) or []:
            if "target" in e and "asset" in e:
                ci_pairs.add((e["target"], e["asset"]))
    compare(f"{paths['ci']} preflight matrix", ci_pairs)
    script = open(paths["script"]).read()
    compare(f"{paths['script']} tuples", set(re.findall(r"^\s*\w+:([^:\s]+):([^\s|\\)]+)[\s|\\)]*$", script, re.M)))
    installer = open(paths["installer"]).read()
    for asset in set(re.findall(r'ASSET_NAME="([^"]+)"', installer)):
        if asset not in rust_assets:
            errs.append(f"{paths['installer']}: asset {asset} disagrees with {paths['config']}")
    return errs

      - name: Download the release asset
        if: steps.latest.outputs.tag != ''
        env:

        run: |

input.message:
I found one confirmed bug and two smaller issues. `just workflow-contracts` exits 0. It only passes outside the sandbox: inside it, the test fixtures' signed commits fail because gpg can't reach keyboxd, which has nothing to do with this diff. `actionlint` on callisto-ci.yml also exits 0.

**Bug (confirmed): a large PR diff can fail the scope job, which then skips the macOS preflights.**
- `macos-preflight-scope.sh` exits as soon as it sees the first matching path, without reading the rest of its input. The step runs `run=$(git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA" HEAD | bash .github/scripts/macos-preflight-scope.sh)` under `set -euo pipefail`.
- If the path list is bigger than the pipe buffer (about 64KB, roughly 1,500 or more paths) and a match comes early, `git diff` gets SIGPIPE. pipefail turns that into exit 141 and `set -e` kills the step.
- Reproduced: piping `Cargo.lock` followed by 200k paths into the script under pipefail exits 141. The repro is `/private/tmp/claude/sigpipe-repro.sh`, with a stand-in producer instead of `git diff`.
- Result: a PR that touches a release path gets a red scope job, and both macOS jobs are skipped.
- Fix: have the script drain stdin before exiting (`cat >/dev/null; echo true; exit 0`), or write the diff to a file first.

**Minor:**
1. **Diff base.** `git diff BASE_SHA HEAD` compares the payload's base SHA with the merge commit. If `base.sha` is behind the base tip the merge ref was built on, changes already on main get counted too. That can only over-match (run when it didn't need to), never miss. `git diff --name-only HEAD^1 HEAD` is exactly the PR's effect on the merge ref and doesn't depend on the payload.
2. **Renames.** `git diff --name-only` turns on rename detection, so a renamed file is listed only under its new path. Moving a file out of `.github/actions/**`, or a `*/Cargo.toml` out of a crate, would therefore not trigger the run. `--no-renames` fixes it.

**Latent, nothing breaks today:**
- When the job-level `if` is false, GitHub skips the matrix job before expanding it. The check then shows up as `Release Artifact Preflight (${{ matrix.id }})`, not `(macos-arm64)` / `(macos-x64)`.
- If those per-target names are ever made required checks, skipped PRs will sit pending forever. The new comment "A skipped job counts as passing" is only true while they aren't required. The ruleset has no required checks now.

**Checked and fine:**
- **Path patterns:**
  - bash `case` `*` also matches `/`, so `.github/actions/*` covers nested files and `*/Cargo.toml` covers any nested manifest.
  - `callisto.toml` matches only at the repo root; the test covers `proto/callisto.toml` as false.
  - `rust-toolchain*` matches the root `rust-toolchain.toml`.
  - There is no `.cargo/config.toml` (only `mutants.toml`) and no `build.rs` anywhere, so nothing else build-affecting is missed.
  - Rust source changes still get macOS coverage, because the `test` job's matrix includes `macos-latest`.
- **Job wiring:** push and merge_group always set `run=true`. Nothing has `needs:` on either preflight job, so no skipped-needs chain. The job-level `if` uses only `needs` outputs, not matrix context.
- **Contract and policy scripts:**
  - `verify-release-workflow-contract.sh` checks for the line `  release-artifact-preflight:` and the macOS and Linux matrix lines anywhere in the file. All are still present.
  - `verify-release-workflow-policy.sh` collects target/asset pairs from every job's matrix, so splitting the jobs doesn't change its set.
- **AGENTS.md:** The new test runs the real script on sample path lists rather than scanning source text. The checkout keeps `persist-credentials: false`, so the contract's checkout count still matches. The action pins are unchanged and there are no emojis.

Files:
- `/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/.claude/worktrees/wp-ci-macos-preflight-scope/.github/scripts/macos-preflight-scope.sh`
- `/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/.claude/worktrees/wp-ci-macos-preflight-scope/.github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml` (the scope job is at line 176, the macOS job at line 202)
